title: Login session expires during issue submission
description:
* Users are logged out while typing a new issue after ~10 minutes of inactivity.
* Draft is not auto-saved; all entered fields are lost.
* Happens on Chrome/Edge desktop in Semester 1 labs.
* Expected: persistent session or autosave until submit.
* Impact: students avoid reporting; duplicate/verbal reports increase.

title: False positives on hairline cracks under low light
description:
* The classifier flags hairline patterns on concrete as “Severe” in <100 lux lighting.
* Reproducible with dataset batch 2025-10-22-night-01.
* Precision drops from 0.89 → 0.63 on the nighttime subset.
* Expected: stable thresholding or adaptive exposure compensation.
* Proposed: add brightness-aware preprocessing + retrain with augmented low-light images.

title: Email notification not sent to reporter on status change
description:
* Dashboard card renders 0% although unit/E2E/coverage all pass on main.
* Last pipeline: build#1249; API /readiness/summary returns 92.
* Suspect rounding in client (Math.floor(undefined) → NaN → 0).
* Expected: score equals backend value, with 1 decimal.
* Add null-guard and unit test for empty metrics.
